Q00337_AudienceWithTheLandDragon/30498-0.text: Warehouse Chief Moke: Ah, a fragment of the Abyssal Jewel and a fang of the jewel guardian! Great job. I will send this fragment to Filaur of the Gray Pillar so that he can destroy it in the "blast furnace of supremacy". This will prevent the seal that restrains Antharas from ever being threatened …

Warehouse Chief Moke: Is that a Feather of Gabrielle? Allow me to introduce myself again. I am Moke, watcher of the seal. I was trained by the Gray Pillar Guild. I am currently employed as a warehouse keeper, guarding the Bronze Gate. For generations we Dwarves have used the power of a seal to bind…

Warehouse Chief Moke: Word has just reached me that another Abyssal Jewel exists! Please go quickly to the Town of Oren and find Blacksmith Helton! He is one of the watchers of the Gray Pillar guild that are fighting the followers of Antharas! Please hurry!

Warehouse Chief Moke: Thanks to your hard work, we have destroyed the two abyss jewels and defended the column restraining the Land Dragon Antharas. On behalf of the brothers of the Gray Pillar guild, I wish to express our deepest gratitude to you. Now, take the marks of watchman you received from …

Warehouse Chief Moke: An Abyssal Jewel is used to focus the power of dark magic into one place. The followers of Antharas are attempting to breach the force field that binds their master. If they are successful it will mean the end of us all. No more tomorrows! We must destroy the Abyssal Jewel as …
